name: connected_components
author: 991d1029
description: Finds the connected components of an UNDIRECTED graph: maximal groups of nodes that are all reachable from each other, with their sizes. Use for questions like 'is the network connected?', 'how many components/clusters/islands are there?', 'what is the largest connected part?' or 'which nodes are isolated?'. Returns an error on directed graphs (use strongly_connected_components there). Returns the top_k largest components (ties broken by smallest node id), each with its size, up to 10 sample nodes, and a graph_id of the component as a subgraph; the summary gives the total number of components and the size of the largest.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the largest components to return.
